decisions.reason: The construction site dumper builds on the firm's vehicle engineering know-how, but it was only mentioned on the website and is close to the underground vehicle lines already withdrawn, so its standing is weaker than the lifts.
The inclined furniture lift line draws directly on the firm's core lifting and material-handling expertise, so management can interpret market feedback and keep improving it.
The inclined building material lift shares technology and construction customers with the furniture lift, making it easy to assimilate and develop within existing knowledge.
The truck-mounted variant extends the established inclined lift platform with vehicle integration the firm understands, though as a single model it carries slightly more risk.
